subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should Session Workspace listings ever expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary or through rejected symlinks?
rationale: The open fix PR changes a gateway file metadata boundary, and automation cannot safely choose between hiding external paths, neutralizing them, or deliberately exposing metadata.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the false-Missing fix should filter or represent them without raw filesystem metadata exposure.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The gateway may report existence and metadata for transcript-mentioned external paths, but that needs explicit tests and documented security semantics before merge.

options.title: Split UI From Backend Semantics
options.body: Land only the remaining layout repair if still needed, while keeping backend Missing semantics open for a separate security-boundary decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the false-Missing fix should filter or represent them without raw filesystem metadata exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and fs-safe refactors make this the strongest available owner for the file metadata boundary choice.
